visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler wearing a brown t-shirt and blue striped shorts is seen from behind, crawling into a large, cream-colored canvas tote bag positioned against a light-colored wall. To the left, a height measurement chart and a partially visible doorway with marble flooring are shown under bright, even indoor lighting. (2) The toddler turns around and sits inside the bag, holding a small pink toy and a blue ball, looking towards the camera with a joyful expression. The camera angle is at eye-level with the child, capturing her smiling face and small hands. (3) The scene shifts to a bedroom with light wood flooring and grey bedding; the toddler is now hiding completely under the same canvas bag, with only her bare feet visible. A woman's hand enters the frame to lift the edge of the bag, revealing the child inside. (4) The child continues to play with the bag on the floor, crawling through it like a tunnel and eventually rolling onto her back while still partially covered, looking up at the camera with curiosity and laughter. (5) The camera captures the child crawling away from the bag across the wooden floor towards an open doorway, her movements active and energetic. (6) The video concludes with a solid pink screen featuring a simple cartoon illustration of the girl and the text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE' centered on the screen.
